_doc: Map 0's survivors upstairs (T-077; gravelight/world/inn_opening/inn_survivors.gd + inn_survivor.gd). Three people off the shut road were resting in the middle guest room (Room 2) when the dead came; they piled the hall furniture against the stair door (Door 1, the Upstairs buy door: its boards and chains are their barricade) and hid. Hidden (not in the world) until a player opens `reveal_door`; then they are in the room, cowering, trembling and pleading, flinching at gunfire. A player holds interact on one to pay `arm.cost` Scrip and hand them `arm.weapon` from the inn's rack: they stand, walk to their post in the hall and hold it, shooting zombies they can see (no Scrip for their kills). Zombies upstairs go for them (Zombie.prey, within `ally.lure_radius` armed / `lure_radius_hidden` hidden, same floor, at most `max_lured` each); each swipe takes `swipe_damage`. Armed ones are downed at 0 hp and can be helped up (hold interact) within `bleed_seconds`; hidden ones and the ones who bleed out die. The dead rise as zombies `rise_after` seconds later, never silently: their last line, a squad line (INN_SURV_TURN) and a groan first; a riser is an extra zombie on top of the round (RoundManager.take_extra_spawn) and only rises while a round is on. Presentation reuses PatronBody (poses cower, aim); no collider, no hitboxes: shots and bots pass through them, nothing walks into them. Co-op: the host decides everything and mirrors it (InnSurvivors._net_*). Positions: Map 0's generator frame (+X east, +Z south), y 3.8 is the upstairs floor. Lines: VO_SCRIPT section 22.

survivors.name: Konrad Wiesner
survivors.speaker: WIE
survivors.role: a railway signalman (50s) from the Kaltenbrunn line, walking home to Hirschfelde since the snow cut the line; he served at Verdun in 1916 and has not held a rifle since

survivors.name: Hedwig Brandt
survivors.speaker: BRA
survivors.role: the schoolteacher (30s) at Hirschfelde, carrying the village children's Christmas letters to the post at Kaltenbrunn when the road shut; brisk, frightened, and braver than she sounds

survivors.name: Ida Kroll
survivors.speaker: KRO
survivors.role: the postwoman (20s) from Sankt Anna on the Christmas round, her bicycle left in a drift on the west road; quick and talkative when she is scared
